profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
Driven by a belief that technology can and should change things for the better. I’m focused on solving meaningful problems at Parachute Health, where the work has real impact on patients and the systems that serve them.

As a full-stack engineer, I build scalable, user-focused applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS.
I hold a B.S. in Computer Science with a Human-Centered Computing concentration from Colorado State University, and I’m deeply curious about how people interact with digital systems, a thread that runs through everything I build.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Outschool, building scalable, reliable systems and tools using React, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, and Kubernetes. I focus on improving infrastructure, automating workflows, and enabling cross-team agility through self-service tools. Key contributions include zero-downtime database upgrades, GDPR compliance, and launching SEO-driven landing pages that boosted organic traffic 11x. Passionate about cloud infrastructure, DevOps best practices, and mentoring teammates to drive operational excellence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Executed project that integrated an open source map library (Leafletjs) to multiple pages of the application, making it possible to visualize the location of 100,000 devices. 
Collaborated closely with UX Designers and the Front End team to achieve a Net Promoter Score of 67.

positions.title: Full Stack Designer
positions.description:
Crafted mobile-first data dashboards using Adobe XD, prioritizing user-centric design principles. 
Continuously honing skills in human-centered design to ensure products resonate with our audience.
Engineered data-driven visualizations with D3.js, elevating data understanding and streamlining analysis processes.

positions.title: Front End Data Science Intern
positions.description:
Revitalized tech infrastructure by overhauling static HTML pages and transforming them into dynamic ReactJS components, significantly reducing technical debt and enhancing scalability and performance.
Engineered innovative, data-driven visualizations utilizing D3.js, enhancing data comprehension and facilitating analysis.

positions.title: Undergarduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Taught the interactive lab of the Introductory Java class, approximately 40 students each semester. Worked one-on-one with students to explain complex concepts and assist them with the mastery of the subject matter. Thought of creative ways to explain technical concepts in non-technical ways.

positions.title: Scheduling Assistant at Campus Recreation
positions.description: Interfaced with affiliate and non-affiliate clients to schedule events and space usage. Worked face-to-face and over the phone to ensure smoothly run events

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented a multi-page monitoring website using ASP, .Net and C# with a usable interface and logical flow, participated in planning the intern day of service. Learned to communicate data driven ideas. Worked on a large team and communicated effectively with off-shore teams.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with a Human Centered Concentration
